name: YAML to JSON
summary: Convert YAML documents to JSON instantly in your browser.
description: Paste YAML and get pretty or minified JSON. Nested maps, arrays, booleans, and numbers are preserved. Conversion runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Does it support multi-document YAML?
faqs.answer: This tool converts a single YAML document. Multi-doc streams can come later.

faqs.question: What about YAML-specific types?
faqs.answer: Values are converted to JSON-friendly forms. Some exotic YAML tags may not round-trip.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
